newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ANZ's Jones named CEO of Metway merger.
newsitem.headline: ANZ's Jones named CEO of Metway merger.

text.p: Queensland-based Metway Bank Ltd said on Monday that the managing director of Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd's (ANZ) New Zealand bank, Steve Jones, would be appointed chief executive of the merged Suncorp/Metway/QIDC group.
Metway chairman designate John Lamble said in a statement he was delighted that Jones would take up his post in December.

"We look forward to the experience and leadership he will bring to both the integration tasks and to setting and carrying out the long term strategy for our exciting flew institution," Lamble said. Metway shareholders approved the merger on November 13 but it does not become legally effective until December 1.
Jones said from Now Zealand in the statement that he saw the three merging companies had strong customer franchises and lines of business which complemented each other well.
"From my initial observations, these three factors provide a terrific foundation for creating future growth and profitability," Jones said.
"The new group will be at the forefront of a world-wide trend toward 'Allfinanz' and I am very excited about the prospects for the business and the opportunity to lead the new organisation," he said.
Jones emigrated to Australia from the United States in 1988, where he had worked for the General Electric Co and McKinsey & Co.
After two years in Australia with McKinsey, Jones formed his own consulting firm and in 1993 was recruited by his client - ANZ Banking Group - to become the head of retail banking in Australia.
In early 1995, he was appointed to his current position as Managing Director of ANZ Banking Group in New Zealand.
ANZ Group chief executive Don Mercer said he could understand Jones' interest in the position and wished him well.
Andrew Ward, ANZ's General Manager Operations and Payment Services, has been appointed Acting Managing Director of ANZ Banking Group (New Zealand) Ltd from December 1.
